delivery: Adopted in unreleased main source; version0.6.39/code46 retained; no APK built
intervention: Residual whole-candidate correction with conservative positive-structure first-choice protection; preserve existing candidate pool and personal ordering

training.algorithm: Whole-candidate residual pairwise logistic ranker with actual decoder path margins

training.feature_support_unit: Distinct (source,context,code,positive); authored variants collapsed to family

training.limitations: Local/skip/boundary evidence, not grammatical proof. Final correction clipping is a training approximation. Missing gold candidates do not train pairs. Repeated competitors and family variants are downweighted. This reranker preserves the existing displayed pool and cannot recover lost search paths.
training.selection: Separate existing authored60,natural200,Tatoeba200 validation; positive structural winner retained, remaining candidates reranked; fresh followup100 evaluated after selection.
training.structural_gate: Any original winner with positive existing completion/handover/clause/clause-start support retains first position; weaker score evidence cannot replace it. Other candidates keep full residual ordering. No full-sentence exception list.
training.training_observations: 800 HKCanCor train utterances,600 Tatoeba train families,240 authored training variants. Related competitors/family variants downweighted. Unreachable targets do not contribute candidate pairs.

selection_before_followup.note: Written before followup guard decoding; earlier observed guards are diagnostic regressions.

runtime.structural_protection: Original winner retained if any existing completion/handover/clause/clause-start support is positive. Remaining candidates retain full residual-score order. Can retain an already-supported wrong first choice; no full-sentence whitelist.

performance.method: PinnedCPU0,12 warmup passes,15 samples; alternating historical/current classloaders in one JVM; no concurrent build/training/decoding benchmark
performance.interpretation: Ordinary cases range about-0.6% to+2.3%;48-letter pressure wall median485.440→456.063ms. JVM/host variability remains. No general/device speedup claim.

release_gate.reason: Natural first-choice gain2pp and authored top-five remains unchanged in this task; earlier discussed targets remain unmet. No major real-user improvement established.

limitations: New followup utterances were excluded from training and prior targets, but come from already-observed heldout conversation sources; speaker independence unavailable.
Older spoken transcripts and community example sentences are not contemporary HK message-frequency data. Some utterance chunks are fragments.
Original natural200 gains6 first choices but loses2;old600 gains15 but loses10. Aggregate protection does not preserve every earlier first choice.
Conservative structural protection can retain supported but incorrect originals; short/role relations are not full semantic or grammatical proof.
Reranking does not recover absent/pruned candidates;new followup100 top20 remains69.
Three rejected policies and reused validation sets informed development; earlier fresh100 is diagnostic after that review.
Desktop JVM timings do not measure Android ART, phone fonts or physical Fold7 latency.
